tex_content.html:
\begin{equation} \lim _{k\to \infty }\widetilde V_{x_k}(\tau )=V_\infty . \end{equation}
Proof

\sketch Reduced volume is positive and non-increasing, begins at $(4\pi )^{n/2}$, and has a limit at infinity. Equality with $(4\pi )^{n/2}$ would force the original flow to be flat by Corollary 4picase; combine this with Claim 2.1.

□

\begin{claim} \end{claim}[Bound for the reduced length at the minimizing point]
